_about: ONE plot-width sanity ceiling, read by BOTH app/src/components/chart/engine/__tests__/lineWidthCapParity.test.js (defSchema.validateDefinition over a member-door document) and tests/test_line_width_cap_parity.py (presentation_schema). TradingView paints a Pine linewidth unclamped (set F: 1..10 is N px); the ceiling stops linewidth = 10000 from smearing the pane of everyone who installs a shared script. `as` = literal (plots[0].width is the number) or input (plots[0].width is $lineWidth and the input default is the number). cases[].ok = the server's save door accepts a NEW document carrying it (no `plot-width`); cases[].drawn = the width it is DRAWN at -- the browser clamps an over-cap stored width to the ceiling instead of refusing the document, and the server's copy clamp (share install, fork) stores exactly that width. grandfathering[] = a save over a stored predecessor (presentation_schema.new_presentation_errors): an over-cap width the stored row already drew is kept (recorded, not enforced) whatever else about the plot changes; ANY change to it is refused. `saved.plot` merges further plot fields (a colour-mode or style edit -- fields the plot's presentation fingerprint names).

grandfathering.name: unchanged over-cap literal, colour mode edited
unchanged over-cap input default, colour mode edited
over-cap literal raised with a colour mode edit
over-cap literal lowered but still over
